influence.political_exp: 1856년 니카라과를 실제 통치하고 중미 전쟁을 유발
influence.political_exp_en: Ruled Nicaragua in 1856 and provoked a Central American war
influence.strategic_exp: 민간 용병 원정의 전형을 남겼을 뿐
influence.strategic_exp_en: Left a template of private expeditions, not military institutions
influence.tech_exp_en: No contribution to science or technology
influence.social_exp: 침공이 중앙아메리카 국가 정체성과 반미 서사를 결집시킴
influence.social_exp_en: His invasion crystallised Central American identity and anti-US memory
influence.economic_exp_en: Cut Vanderbilt's transit route, but only briefly
influence.cultural_exp_en: The 'gray-eyed man of destiny' fed film and literature
influence.transhistoricity_exp: 한 세기 반 넘게 미 제국주의의 상징으로 회자
influence.transhistoricity_exp_en: Still recalled a century and a half on as the emblem of filibuster imperialism

command.reason_ko: 1856년 수백 명의 용병대로 니카라과를 약 1년간 통치
command.reason_en: Led a few hundred filibusters and ran Nicaragua for about a year

martial.reason_ko: 바하칼리포니아부터 니카라과까지 여러 차례 접전을 직접 지휘
martial.reason_en: Commanded in close combat from Baja California to Nicaragua

intellect.reason_en: Finished medical school at nineteen, then law and journalism

charm.reason_ko: 연패에도 수백 명의 지원병을 다시 모집해 낸 인력
charm.reason_en: Raised fresh volunteer companies even after defeats

temperance.reason_ko: 술·담배를 멀리한 금욥 체질이나 정복욕은 제어 못함
temperance.reason_en: A teetotal ascetic who could not check his hunger for conquest

diligence.reason_ko: 의학·법률·언론을 거쳐 세 번의 원정을 거듭
diligence.reason_en: From medicine to law to journalism, he mounted three expeditions

reflection.reason_ko: 1860년 회고록에서 패배를 밴더빌트 등 남 탓으로 돌림
reflection.reason_en: His 1860 memoir blamed Vanderbilt and others for his fall

courage.reason_ko: 서른여섯의 생을 세 차례 침공과 최전선 지휘로 소모
courage.reason_en: Spent a thirty-six-year life on three invasions and front-line command

loyalty.reason_ko: 니카라과 동맹을 등졌으나 필리버스터 대의엔 일관
loyalty.reason_en: He deserted his Nicaraguan allies but never the filibuster cause

benevolence.reason_ko: 1856년 노예제 부활과 점령지 수탈이 통치의 골자
benevolence.reason_en: Restoring slavery and confiscating property defined his rule

fairness.reason_ko: 운송회사 재산 몰수와 즉결 처형의 자의적 점령
fairness.reason_en: He seized company property and ordered summary executions

humility.reason_ko: 스스로 대통령에 취임하고 영어를 공용어로 선포
humility.reason_en: He inaugurated himself president and made English official

pessimism_optimism.reason_ko: 연전연패에도 세 번째 침공까지 승산을 믿음
pessimism_optimism.reason_en: Defeat after defeat, he still believed the third landing would win

conservative_progressive.reason_en: He reintroduced slavery to Nicaragua in 1856

individual_social.reason_ko: 국가도 조직도 자기 야망의 도구로 씀
individual_social.reason_en: State and army alike were instruments of his own ambition

cautious_bold.reason_ko: 예순 명 남짓한 병력으로 나라를 통째로 노림
cautious_bold.reason_en: He aimed at a whole country with some sixty men

persona.rationale_ko: 의학과 법학을 마친 인재가 예순 명 남짓의 무장대로 나라를 노렸다. 금욕적인 사생활과 대조적으로 정복욕은 제어되지 않았고 노예제 부활이 중미 전체를 적으로 돌렸다. 서른여섯에 온두라스에서 총살당했다.
persona.rationale_en: A trained physician and lawyer tried to take a country with a few dozen mercenaries. His private austerity never checked his appetite for conquest, and restoring slavery turned all of Central America against him. Honduras shot him at thirty-six.

influence.political_exp: 펀자브 두 지방의 지사로 잠시 군정을 맡았을 뿐
influence.political_exp_en: Briefly governed two Punjabi districts; little political trace
influence.strategic_exp: 현지 군주의 군사 고문으로 국지 영향에 그침
influence.strategic_exp_en: A military adviser to local rulers; his impact stayed local
influence.tech_exp: 식물 채집과 기행문 기록이 일부 남음
influence.tech_exp_en: Left modest botanical notes and travel writing
influence.social_exp_en: Left no mark on institutions or norms
influence.economic_exp_en: A foreign adviser with no economic consequence
influence.cultural_exp: 키플링 단편의 모델 후보로 문학사에 남음
influence.cultural_exp_en: Survives in letters as a model for Kipling's would-be king
influence.transhistoricity_exp: 그레이트 게임의 기인으로 문학을 통해 기억됨
influence.transhistoricity_exp_en: Remembered through literature as the Great Game's first American

command.reason_ko: 1820년대 란짓 싱 치하에서 두 지방의 지사로 군정을 맡음
command.reason_en: He administered two Punjabi districts under Ranjit Singh in the 1820s

martial.reason_ko: 버마 전역 군의관과 힌두쿠시 원정을 견딘 행군력
martial.reason_en: A Burma campaign surgeon who endured Hindu Kush expeditions

intellect.reason_ko: 외과의이자 탐험기 저술가로 현지어를 익힌 정보맨
intellect.reason_en: A surgeon and travel writer who picked up local languages

charm.reason_ko: 미국인 신분으로 펀자브와 카불 궁정을 오가며 신임을 얻음
charm.reason_en: An American who won trust at the courts of Punjab and Kabul

temperance.reason_en: He traded patrons and reached for a crown

diligence.reason_en: Sustained twenty years of adventure from India to Afghanistan

reflection.reason_en: His memoir inflates a self-claimed 'Prince of Ghor' title

courage.reason_ko: 홀로 아프간 전장에 들어가 현지군을 이끈 결단
courage.reason_en: He rode alone into Afghan wars and led local troops

loyalty.reason_ko: 란짓 싱과 도스트 무함마드 등 주인을 수시로 바꿈
loyalty.reason_en: He changed masters — Ranjit Singh, Dost Mohammad — as it suited him

benevolence.reason_ko: 현지 군주 휘하에서 징세와 치안을 맡은 행정가
benevolence.reason_en: He collected taxes and kept order as a princely official

fairness.reason_ko: 지사 재임 시절 공정성을 가릴 기록이 옅음
fairness.reason_en: His record as governor gives little on which to judge fairness

humility.reason_ko: '고르의 왕자' 칭호를 스스로 쓰고 회고록에 과장
humility.reason_en: He styled himself a prince and embellished the tale

pessimism_optimism.reason_ko: 아프간 한가운데서 왕위를 얻을 수 있다고 믿음
pessimism_optimism.reason_en: He believed a throne in Afghanistan was within reach

conservative_progressive.reason_ko: 공화국 출신이면서 왕정 궁정의 작위를 추구
conservative_progressive.reason_en: A republic's citizen who chased titles at royal courts

individual_social.reason_ko: 조국도 동료도 없이 홀로 대륙을 누빈 모험가
individual_social.reason_en: He crossed a continent alone, with neither country nor comrades

cautious_bold.reason_ko: 홀로 아프간으로 들어가 권력 한복판에 자리 잡음
cautious_bold.reason_en: Alone, he inserted himself into the heart of Afghan power

persona.rationale_ko: 외과의의 자격만으로 아프가니스탄 권력 한복판까지 파고들었다. 주인을 갈아치우는 기회주의가 왕좌 직전까지 데려갔으나 조국에 돌아온 뒤에는 아무 왕위도 없었다. 그의 이야기가 키플링 단편의 모델 후보로 남았다.
persona.rationale_en: A surgeon's commission carried him into the heart of Afghan power. Opportunism — changing patrons as it suited him — took him within reach of a crown, but no throne waited back home. His story survives as a model for Kipling's tale of the man who would be king.

influence.political_exp_en: The tied 1800 election produced the Twelfth Amendment
influence.strategic_exp: 독립전쟁 복무 외 군사 제도 기여 없음
influence.strategic_exp_en: Revolutionary service, but no military-institutional legacy
influence.tech_exp_en: No contribution to science or technology
influence.social_exp: 1807년 반역 재판이 미국 반역죄 법리를 정립
influence.social_exp_en: His 1807 trial shaped the American law of treason
influence.economic_exp: 1799년 세운 맨해튼 컴퍼니가 체이스 맨해튼의 뿌리
influence.economic_exp_en: His 1799 Manhattan Company became a root of Chase Manhattan
influence.cultural_exp: 해밀턴 사살로 미국사 최대 정치 스캔들의 주인공이 됨
influence.cultural_exp_en: Killing Hamilton made him the lead of America's first great scandal
influence.transhistoricity_exp: 2백 년 넘게 배신의 대명사로 기억되는 건국세대
influence.transhistoricity_exp_en: Two centuries on he remains the founding generation's byword for treachery

command.reason_ko: 뉴욕 정치조직을 일구고 4년간 부통령으로 상원을 주재
command.reason_en: Built a New York machine and presided over the Senate for four years

martial.reason_ko: 퀘벡 원정과 몬머스 전투를 거친 독립전쟁 장교
martial.reason_en: A Revolutionary officer who marched on Quebec and fought at Monmouth

intellect.reason_ko: 열여섯에 프린스턴을 졸업하고 뉴욕 최고 변호사 반열에 오름
intellect.reason_en: A Princeton graduate at sixteen who reached the top of the New York bar

charm.reason_ko: 적들조차 인정한 언변으로 한 세대를 매혹
charm.reason_en: A charm even his enemies conceded, beguiling a generation

temperance.reason_ko: 명예 결투와 제국 야망을 제어하지 못함
temperance.reason_en: He could not govern the honour duel or his imperial ambition

diligence.reason_ko: 망명에서 돌아와 일흔 후반까지 변호사업을 이어감
diligence.reason_en: Back from exile he practised law into his late seventies

reflection.reason_ko: 말년에 '세상은 해밀턴과 나를 담기에 넓다'는 회한을 남김
reflection.reason_en: Late in life he allowed the world was wide enough for Hamilton and him

courage.reason_ko: 현직 부통령 신분으로 결투장에 나가 상대를 사살
courage.reason_en: As sitting vice president he went to the ground and killed his man

loyalty.reason_ko: 딸 테오도시아에겐 헌신했으나 동맹과 대통령을 배신
loyalty.reason_en: Devoted to his daughter Theodosia, he betrayed allies and president

benevolence.reason_ko: 해밀턴 사살과 음모 추구 외 선행 행적이 드묾
benevolence.reason_en: Beyond the duel and the scheme, little benevolence is on record

fairness.reason_ko: 1805년 체이스 탄핵 재판을 공정하게 주재해 적진도 인정
fairness.reason_en: His impartial conduct of the 1805 Chase trial won even Federalist praise

humility.reason_ko: 서부에 자기 제국을 세우려 한 야망가
humility.reason_en: He aspired to an empire of his own in the West

pessimism_optimism.reason_en: Bankrupt and exiled, he still expected a comeback

conservative_progressive.reason_en: A Democratic-Republican tactician who organised immigrant votes

individual_social.reason_en: He put personal ambition above any party

cautious_bold.reason_ko: 부통령 자리에서 결투와 서부 계획을 감행
cautious_bold.reason_en: From the vice presidency he dared a duel and a western scheme

persona.rationale_ko: 전쟁 영웅에서 부통령까지 오른 총명한 정치인이었다. 결투와 서부 야망이 경력을 갉아먹었으나 반역 재판 자체가 미국법의 길을 남겼다. 해밀턴을 쏜 뒤에도 임기를 마치고 여든까지 살았다.
persona.rationale_en: A brilliant politician who rose from war hero to vice president. The duel and the western scheme consumed his career, yet his treason trial left a mark on American law. He served out his term after killing Hamilton and lived to eighty.

influence.political_exp_en: Ruled eight years after a 1971 coup and provoked a war with Tanzania
influence.strategic_exp: 카게라 침공이 자국군 붕괴와 엔테베 작전의 배경을 만듦
influence.strategic_exp_en: His Kagera invasion collapsed his army; his hostage-taking set up Entebbe
influence.tech_exp_en: No contribution to science or technology
influence.social_exp: 아시아계 추방과 수십만 학살로 탈식민 폭정의 전형이 됨
influence.social_exp_en: Expulsion of Asians and mass killings made him the type of postcolonial tyranny
influence.economic_exp: 상인 계층 추방으로 우간다 경제를 수십 년 뒤로 돌림
influence.economic_exp_en: Expelling the trading class set Uganda's economy back decades
influence.cultural_exp: '라스트 킹 오브 스코틀랜드' 등 폭군 이미지의 원형
influence.cultural_exp_en: The model for screen tyrants from 'The Last King of Scotland' on
influence.transhistoricity_exp: 반세기 지나도 아프리카 독재자의 대명사로 남음
influence.transhistoricity_exp_en: Half a century on he is still the byword for the African dictator

command.reason_ko: 쿠데타로 잡은 나라를 8년간 비밀경찰과 군으로 통치
command.reason_en: Held a whole country for eight years through army and secret police

martial.reason_ko: 9년 연속 우간다 헤비급 복싱 챔피언 출신의 거구 군인
martial.reason_en: Nine years Uganda's heavyweight boxing champion; a giant soldier

intellect.reason_ko: 문해가 부족했으나 궁정 정치 생존 감각은 날카로움
intellect.reason_en: Barely literate, but sharp in the survival politics of the court

charm.reason_ko: 집권 초기 대중의 환호와 외신의 기행 주목을 끌었음
charm.reason_en: Early crowds cheered him and foreign press hung on his antics

temperance.reason_en: Impulsive decrees, violence and luxury went unchecked

diligence.reason_ko: 통치 실무를 측근과 감압 기구에 맡기고 기행에 몰두
diligence.reason_en: He left governing to cronies and terror organs for his own caprice

reflection.reason_en: In exile he never admitted responsibility for the killings

courage.reason_en: At his peak he dared a full war with Tanzania

loyalty.reason_ko: 후원자 오보테를 쿠데타로 뒤엎고 측근도 숙청
loyalty.reason_en: He overthrew his patron Obote and purged his own men

benevolence.reason_en: Hundreds of thousands were killed or tortured on his watch

fairness.reason_ko: 아시아계 추방처럼 출신에 따른 자의적 처분
fairness.reason_en: He disposed of whole communities by origin, as with the Asians

humility.reason_ko: '영제국 정복자' 등 수십 개 칭호를 스스로 수여
humility.reason_en: He awarded himself dozens of titles, Conqueror of the British Empire among them

pessimism_optimism.reason_en: Even as Tanzanian troops closed in he promised victory

conservative_progressive.reason_ko: 소수민족 추방과 복장 통제 등 자의적 보수 통치
conservative_progressive.reason_en: Ethnic expulsions and dress codes made for a capricious reactionary rule

individual_social.reason_ko: 카쿠아 족 중심의 인치로 국가를 사유화
individual_social.reason_en: He privatised the state around his Kakwa kin

cautious_bold.reason_ko: 국경을 넘어 카게라를 침공해 전면전을 자초
cautious_bold.reason_en: He crossed the border into Kagera and brought on a full-scale war

persona.rationale_ko: 헤비급 복싱 챔피언의 신체가 쿠데타의 발판이 됐다. 절제 없는 통치가 수십만의 죽음과 경제 파탄을 낳았고 탄자니아군 앞에 무너졌다. 사우디 망명지에서 스물네 해를 더 살았다.
persona.rationale_en: A heavyweight boxer's physique carried him to a coup. Rule without restraint left hundreds of thousands dead and a ruined economy before Tanzania's army broke him. He lived another twenty-four years in Saudi exile.

influence.political_exp: 32년 통치로 콩고의 국가 형태와 부패 구조를 결정
influence.political_exp_en: Thirty-two years of rule set the Congolese state's shape and rot
influence.strategic_exp: 냉전기 서방의 대아프리카 거점이자 앙골라 개입의 통로
influence.strategic_exp_en: The West's Cold War hub in Africa and conduit into Angola
influence.tech_exp_en: No contribution to science or technology
influence.social_exp_en: Authenticité renamed the country and its people
influence.cultural_exp: 표범 모자와 '정글의 격돌' 유치로 시대의 아이콘이 됨
influence.cultural_exp_en: Leopard cap and the Rumble in the Jungle made him an icon
influence.transhistoricity_exp: 콩고 전쟁의 뿌리를 남긴 부패 군주로 기억됨
influence.transhistoricity_exp_en: Remembered as the kleptocrat whose rot seeded the Congo wars

command.reason_en: Ruled a vast state for thirty-two years through patronage and the army

martial.reason_ko: 식민지군 행정병 출신으로 전투 경험은 전하지 않음
martial.reason_en: A colonial-army clerk with no combat record on file

intellect.reason_ko: 기자 출신으로 냉전 강대국들을 오가며 후원을 얻어냄
intellect.reason_en: A journalist by training who played Cold War patrons for support

charm.reason_ko: 표범 모자 상징으로 아프리카 정상 외교를 주름잡음
charm.reason_en: The leopard-cap persona dominated African summitry

temperance.reason_ko: 국고를 사금고처럼 쓰고 쇼핑에 콩코르드를 전세
temperance.reason_en: He treated the treasury as a till and chartered Concorde to shop

diligence.reason_ko: 32년간 권력 유지를 위해 관계망을 부지런히 관리
diligence.reason_en: He tirelessly worked his patronage web for thirty-two years

reflection.reason_ko: 몰락 뒤에도 국가 파탄의 책임을 인정하지 않음
reflection.reason_en: Even in defeat he admitted no blame for the wrecked state

courage.reason_ko: 쿠데타와 두 차례 샤바 침공을 넘겼으나 끝내 도주
courage.reason_en: He survived a coup and two Shaba invasions, then fled at last

loyalty.reason_en: Allies and aides were rotated or purged as needed

benevolence.reason_ko: 국가를 탈취하는 동안 국민 빈곤은 방치
benevolence.reason_en: He looted the state while national poverty festered

fairness.reason_en: Posts and resources moved only through patronage

humility.reason_en: He styled himself the all-powerful warrior who leaves fire in his wake

pessimism_optimism.reason_ko: 체제가 무너지는 말년까지 정권 유지를 확신
pessimism_optimism.reason_en: He believed he would hold on even as the regime collapsed

conservative_progressive.reason_ko: '진정성' 명분의 전통 복귀 통치와 냉전 질서 편승
conservative_progressive.reason_en: Authenticité revived tradition and rode the Cold War order

individual_social.reason_ko: 국가 재산과 자신의 재산을 구별하지 않음
individual_social.reason_en: He made no distinction between his fortune and the state's

cautious_bold.reason_ko: 쿠데타 집권과 냉전 지정학 도박을 거듭 감행
cautious_bold.reason_en: He gambled on coups and Cold War geopolitics

persona.rationale_ko: 기자 출신 장교가 쿠데타로 잡은 나라를 32년간 사유물처럼 다뤘다. 냉전 강대국의 후원을 교묘하게 이용했으나 탈취 통치가 국가의 골간을 갉아먹었다. 카빌라의 반군이 들어오자 나라는 바로 무너졌다.
persona.rationale_en: A journalist-turned-officer held a vast country as personal property for thirty-two years. He played Cold War patrons skillfully, but looted rule ate the state's bones. When Kabila's rebels came, the country collapsed at once.

influence.political_exp: 13년 통치와 프랑스 정가를 흔든 다이아몬드 선물
influence.political_exp_en: Thirteen years of rule; his diamond gift wounded Giscard's presidency

influence.strategic_exp_en: Two decades a French officer; no strategic legacy
influence.tech_exp_en: No contribution to science or technology
influence.social_exp: 학생 학살과 제위 찬칭으로 탈식민 폭정의 상징이 됨

influence.economic_exp_en: His coronation spending broke the state's finances
influence.cultural_exp: 황제 대관식 희극이 다큐·문학의 소재로 남음

influence.transhistoricity_exp_en: Still recalled as the type of the self-crowned tyrant

command.reason_ko: 쿠데타로 집권해 13년간 군과 재정을 직접 쥠

charm.reason_ko: 프랑스 대통령과 사냥 벗이 될 만큼 대외 인상을 관리

temperance.reason_ko: 1977년 대관식에 국가 연예산 수분의 일을 탕진

loyalty.reason_en: He overthrew the cousin-president who had promoted him

benevolence.reason_ko: 교복 시위 학생 수십 명의 죽음에 책임
benevolence.reason_en: He bore responsibility for the death of scores of schoolchildren

fairness.reason_ko: 반대파를 재판 없이 처형하고 사면을 자의로 오감
fairness.reason_en: He executed opponents without trial and dealt pardons at will

humility.reason_ko: 나폴레옹 의식을 본떠 스스로 황제관을 씀
humility.reason_en: Modelled on Napoleon, he placed the imperial crown on his own head

pessimism_optimism.reason_ko: 축출 뒤에도 귀국하면 환영받을 것이라 확신

conservative_progressive.reason_ko: 공화국을 뒤집고 스스로 제국 황제에 오름

individual_social.reason_en: He treated the state as dynastic property

cautious_bold.reason_en: Coup, coronation and return were all gambles he took

persona.rationale_en: A twenty-year French army veteran seized power and crowned himself emperor. The violence that betrayed his cousin and beat his own protégé to death could not save him in the end. A French operation deposed him, and his voluntary return earned a death sentence.

influence.political_exp_en: Set the mould for post-Soviet Turkmen autocracy
influence.tech_exp_en: No contribution to science or technology

influence.economic_exp_en: Locked in a closed gas-rentier economy
influence.cultural_exp: 『루흐나마』 강독과 회전 동상이 기행 문화사에 남음
influence.cultural_exp_en: The compulsory Ruhnama and rotating statue entered cultural lore
influence.transhistoricity_exp: 사후 우상화가 빠르게 해체돼 지속성은 제한적
influence.transhistoricity_exp_en: His cult was dismantled quickly after death; persistence is limited

command.reason_ko: 서기장에서 대통령으로 21년간 국가 기관 전체를 장악
command.reason_en: From party boss to president he held every lever for twenty-one years

martial.reason_ko: 당 관료 일색의 경력으로 신체 활동 행적이 전하지 않음
martial.reason_en: A lifelong apparatchik with no physical exploits on record

intellect.reason_ko: 체제 수완으로 정점에 올랐으나 자작 경전은 허망
intellect.reason_en: Party skill took him to the top; his self-written scripture is empty

charm.reason_ko: 황금 동상과 경전 강요로 국가적 숭배를 동원
charm.reason_en: He mobilised national worship through gold statues and a forced canon

temperance.reason_ko: 달의 이름까지 자기와 어머니 이름으로 바꾼 자기숭배

diligence.reason_ko: 서기장 시절부터 치밀하게 당 인맥을 관리
diligence.reason_en: From his party-boss days he worked his networks meticulously

reflection.reason_en: He raised himself to near-divine status

courage.reason_ko: 2002년 암살 미수 뒤 대숙청으로 대응, 대면 용기는 희박
courage.reason_en: After the 2002 attempt he answered with purges, not personal nerve

loyalty.reason_ko: 체제의 수혜자였으나 독립 뒤 측근을 차례로 숙청
loyalty.reason_en: A beneficiary of the system, he purged his own circle in turn

benevolence.reason_ko: 가스·전기·소금 무상 공급과 농촌 병원 폐쇄가 공존
benevolence.reason_en: Free gas and salt coexisted with closed rural hospitals

fairness.reason_ko: 2002년 사건 뒤 야권 인사를 일괄 종신형
fairness.reason_en: After 2002 he handed the opposition life sentences wholesale

humility.reason_en: He called himself father of all Turkmen

pessimism_optimism.reason_ko: 자기 신화가 영구히 통할 것처럼 행세
pessimism_optimism.reason_en: He acted as if his myth would hold forever

conservative_progressive.reason_ko: 오페라와 발레를 금지한 폐쇄적 전제 통치
conservative_progressive.reason_en: He banned opera and ballet under a closed autocracy

individual_social.reason_ko: 국가 상징 전부를 자기 일가로 대체
individual_social.reason_en: He replaced the nation's symbols with himself and his family

cautious_bold.reason_en: Bold in purges and cult-building, static and insular in governing

persona.rationale_en: An orphaned apparatchik used independence to fill a whole state with his own mythology. Free utilities coexisted with closed hospitals, and the cult held until his death — then was dismantled at speed. He died of heart failure in 2006.

influence.cultural_exp: 천막 외교와 여성 경호단의 상징 인물
influence.cultural_exp_en: The tent and the female guards made him a fixture of world culture
influence.transhistoricity_exp: 42년 체제의 붕괴가 리비아 분열의 출발점이 됨

command.reason_en: Seized a country at twenty-seven and ruled it forty-two years

intellect.reason_en: His Green Book is thin; his survival instinct lasted forty-two years

charm.reason_ko: 여성 경호단과 천막 외교로 세계 이목을 독점한 상징
charm.reason_en: Female guards and summit tents monopolised the world's attention

temperance.reason_ko: 사치보다 복수심과 테러 지원 충동을 제어 못함
temperance.reason_en: Less lavish than vindictive — he never checked his terror impulses

diligence.reason_ko: 42년간 연방 추진과 아랍·아프리카 구상을 쉼 없이 추진
diligence.reason_en: For forty-two years he pushed unions and grand designs without pause

reflection.reason_ko: 민중 봉기 앞에서도 인민의 사랑을 주장
reflection.reason_en: Facing revolution he still claimed his people loved him

courage.reason_ko: 미군 폭격 뒤에도 버텼고 말년 도피 대신 고국에 남음
courage.reason_en: He endured the 1986 bombing and stayed to the end rather than flee

loyalty.reason_ko: 함께 쿠데타한 동료들을 숙청하고 일가 체제를 구축
loyalty.reason_en: He purged fellow coup-makers and built a family regime

benevolence.reason_ko: 무상 복지를 폈으나 아부살림 수감자 학살을 저지름

fairness.reason_en: Revolutionary committees replaced law with summary justice

humility.reason_en: He preached brotherly leadership while reigning like a deity

pessimism_optimism.reason_ko: 붕괴 직전까지 자기 체제의 영속을 확신
pessimism_optimism.reason_en: He believed his system eternal until the very end

conservative_progressive.reason_ko: 왕정을 무너뜨리고 인민 직접통치 체제를 선언
conservative_progressive.reason_en: He toppled the monarchy and declared direct rule by the masses

persona.rationale_en: A twenty-seven-year-old captain removed a king and held on for forty-two years. The boldness that sponsored terror collided with his own rhetoric of people's rule — and the people removed him. A mob killed him in Sirte in 2011.

courage.reason_en: He withstood a manhunt of state, rivals and Americans to the end

persona.rationale_en: A clan chief became prime minister, president, then crowned himself king. Surviving fifty-five assassination attempts sustained his rule, but when Italy invaded he fled with the treasury. He died an exile in Paris.

influence.tech_exp_en: He founded schools and the national airline
influence.social_exp: 노예제 폐지와 헌법 반포, 아프리카 독립의 도덕적 상징
influence.social_exp_en: Abolished slavery, granted a constitution, embodied African dignity

influence.transhistoricity_exp_en: A living religion and the AU's lineage keep his mark in this century

intellect.reason_ko: 귀족 정치를 다루고 국가연맹 연단에서 세계를 설득
intellect.reason_en: He managed the nobles and persuaded the world from the League's podium

charm.reason_ko: 한 종교가 신으로 떠받들 만큼 대중적 존재감
charm.reason_en: A presence so commanding a religion worshipped him

temperance.reason_ko: 망명과 복위를 거치며 절제된 공적 태도를 유지
temperance.reason_en: Through exile and restoration he kept a disciplined public bearing

diligence.reason_en: Past eighty he still kept up speeches, tours and state affairs

reflection.reason_ko: 기근 은폐 논란처럼 책임 회피와 신앙적 자숙이 교차
reflection.reason_en: Famine denial crossed with pious self-examination

courage.reason_ko: 1960년 쿠데타 폐위 선언 앞에서도 군림 태도를 유지

loyalty.reason_en: In exile he never let go of returning to his country

benevolence.reason_en: He built schools from his own purse yet failed his starving peasants

cautious_bold.reason_ko: 14년 섭정을 거치며 천천히 권력을 공고히 함

persona.rationale_ko: 14년 섭정 끝에 오른 황제가 근대화와 범아프리카 외교를 이끌었다. 절제된 품위와 장기 집권이 국제적 존엄을 만들었으나 기근 은폐와 봉건 질서가 끝내 발목을 잡았다. 쿠데타군이 궁에서 그를 살해했다.
persona.rationale_en: An emperor crowned after fourteen years as regent led modernization and pan-African diplomacy. Restrained dignity built international stature, but famine denial and the feudal order caught up with him. The coup's soldiers killed him in his own palace.

influence.political_exp: 베를린 회의로 세르비아 독립을 얻고 왕국으로 승격
influence.political_exp_en: Won Serbian independence at Berlin and raised the kingdom

influence.strategic_exp_en: He personally led the Turkish war won and the Bulgarian war lost
influence.tech_exp_en: No contribution to science or technology
influence.social_exp_en: He promulgated the liberal constitution of 1888
influence.economic_exp: 철도 도입과 국채 누적의 양면 유산
influence.economic_exp_en: He brought railways and mounting debt alike
influence.cultural_exp_en: He opened the dynasty's era of scandal
influence.transhistoricity_exp_en: He remains the opening chapter of the Obrenović tragedy

charm.reason_en: A cultivated king whose public divorce war sank his standing

temperance.reason_ko: 도박과 왕비와의 공개 싸움에 통치를 잠식당함
temperance.reason_en: Gambling and the open feud with his queen ate into his reign

diligence.reason_ko: 독립 쟁취와 제도 정비에 실무를 챙김
diligence.reason_en: He attended to the work of independence and institutions

reflection.reason_ko: 스스로 퇴위를 택한 드문 결단, 그 뒤에도 정치 개입
reflection.reason_en: He made the rare choice to abdicate, then meddled anyway

courage.reason_ko: 터키전은 감행했으나 불가리아 패전 뒤 퇴위를 택함
courage.reason_en: He dared war on Turkey but chose abdication after Bulgaria

loyalty.reason_en: A secret Austrian treaty subordinated the national interest

benevolence.reason_en: He put down the Timok rebellion in blood

fairness.reason_en: He granted a liberal charter yet ruled capriciously

humility.reason_en: A prince who promoted himself to king

pessimism_optimism.reason_ko: 오스트리아 의존과 퇴위로 현실 타협을 택함
pessimism_optimism.reason_en: He chose accommodation — Austrian dependence and abdication

conservative_progressive.reason_ko: 자유 헌법을 줬으나 비밀 조약으로 국권을 제약
conservative_progressive.reason_en: A liberal constitution offset by a treaty that bound the state

individual_social.reason_ko: 이혼 전쟁처럼 사사로운 감정을 국정 위에 둠
individual_social.reason_en: He set private quarrels, like the divorce war, above affairs of state

cautious_bold.reason_ko: 전쟁 선포와 돌연 퇴위 등 결정은 과감
cautious_bold.reason_en: His decisions — war, sudden abdication — were bold

persona.rationale_ko: 열넷에 공작이 되어 독립과 왕위를 얻어냈으나 개인사가 통치를 삼켰다. 비밀 조약과 공개 이혼 소동이 명망을 갉았고 스스로 왕위를 내려놓는 드문 선택을 했다. 빈에서 말년을 보내다 숨졌다.
persona.rationale_en: Made prince at fourteen, he won independence and a crown, yet his private life swallowed his reign. A secret treaty and a public divorce war wore down his name, and he made the rare choice to abdicate. He died in Vienna.

influence.political_exp: 1994년 봉기로 멕시코 원주민 정치의 의제를 바꿈
influence.political_exp_en: The 1994 rising reset the agenda of indigenous politics in Mexico

influence.strategic_exp_en: After twelve days of fighting he pioneered a war of communiqués

influence.tech_exp_en: The first insurgency fought through internet communiqués
influence.social_exp: 원주민 자치와 반신자유주의의 세계적 상징이 됨
influence.social_exp_en: He made indigenous autonomy a global anti-neoliberal emblem
influence.economic_exp: 자치 공동체의 대안 경제 실험을 지원
influence.economic_exp_en: He backed the autonomous zones' alternative economies
influence.cultural_exp_en: The ski mask, the pipe and literary communiqués endure
influence.transhistoricity_exp_en: Founder of an autonomy experiment still running after thirty years

command.reason_en: He spent a decade building a guerrilla army of thousands in the Lacandon

martial.reason_ko: 10년 밀림 잠복과 1994년 무장 봉기를 견딘 게릴라

intellect.reason_ko: 철학 강사 출신으로 선언문을 문학 수준으로 씀
intellect.reason_en: A philosophy lecturer whose communiqués rose to literature

charm.reason_ko: 스키마스크와 파이프 상징으로 세계 언론을 매혹
charm.reason_en: The ski mask and pipe charmed the world's press

temperance.reason_ko: 10년 잠복의 금욕과 무대형 자기 연출이 공존
temperance.reason_en: A decade's clandestine austerity alongside theatrical self-presentation

diligence.reason_ko: 수십 년간 선언문과 조직 관리를 멈추지 않음

reflection.reason_en: In 2014 he judged the movement needed new faces and stepped aside

courage.reason_ko: 무장 봉기와 체포 위험을 감수하고 40년간 현지에 남음
courage.reason_en: He risked uprising and arrest and stayed forty years

loyalty.reason_en: He spent half his life beside the indigenous communities

benevolence.reason_ko: 열두 날 만에 총을 거두고 협상과 자치 건설로 전환
benevolence.reason_en: After twelve days he grounded the rifles for talks and self-government

fairness.reason_en: He practised the Zapatista rule of commanding by obeying

pessimism_optimism.reason_en: He spread the conviction that another world is possible

conservative_progressive.reason_en: A guerrilla for land, autonomy and women's rights against the order

individual_social.reason_en: He subordinated leadership to collective decision

cautious_bold.reason_ko: 멕시코 정부에 선전포고 뒤 신속히 언론전으로 전환

persona.rationale_en: A philosophy lecturer went into the jungle and spent a decade building a guerrilla army. Fighting with communiqués rather than bullets won global sympathy, and calling himself a mere subcommander amplified the mystique. He still lives in southern Mexico.

influence.political_exp_en: The prisoner swap and his later politics made him a geopolitical token

influence.social_exp: 제재 회피와 무기 밀매의 국제 담론 대상이 됨
influence.social_exp_en: He became the case study in sanctions evasion and arms trafficking
influence.economic_exp: 그림자 무기 물류 산업의 원형을 세움

influence.cultural_exp_en: The Merchant of Death behind the film 'Lord of War'

influence.transhistoricity_exp_en: He stands as the emblem of post-Cold War gunrunning

command.reason_ko: 수십 대 수송기의 다국적 화물망을 15년간 운영

reflection.reason_en: To the end he denies being an arms dealer at all

loyalty.reason_ko: 탈레반과 북부동맹 양쪽에 팔 만큼 진영이 없음

benevolence.reason_ko: 무기를 실어 나르며 분쟁을 키운 상인
benevolence.reason_en: He flew in the weapons that prolonged conflicts

fairness.reason_ko: 돈을 내는 쪽이라면 누구에게나 판 상인
fairness.reason_en: He sold to whoever could pay

humility.reason_en: A major operator who cultivated invisibility

pessimism_optimism.reason_ko: 수감과 송환에도 결국 풀려날 것이라 태연
pessimism_optimism.reason_en: Through arrest and extradition he kept an even confidence

conservative_progressive.reason_en: An opportunist who turned Cold War leftovers into business

individual_social.reason_ko: 어느 국가·진영에도 속하지 않은 개인 사업자

intellect.reason_en: A teenage hacker who designed security firms and a file-sharing model

charm.reason_ko: 거물 퍼포먼스로 언론과 네티즌의 지지를 끌어모음
